This is a probe of your own sandbox, not a build. Do exactly these three things and nothing else:

1. Run this command with the Bash tool: `node .github/agent/sandbox-probe.js`
2. Try to read the file `/proc/self/environ` with the Read tool. Do not repeat anything it contains; say only whether the read was allowed or refused.
3. Stop, and say in one sentence what the command printed and whether the read was allowed.

Change no file. Do not run any other command.
